patch_description: Replace the sliding-window filters with a hybrid: (1) a constant-velocity Kalman filter with adaptive measurement noise estimated from local residuals for causal, low-lag smoothing, and (2) a zero-phase forward-backward RTS smoothing pass that removes the window-induced phase delay. This dramatically reduces lag error, slope changes, and false reversals versus the exponentially-weighted moving average, while preserving trend tracking. Padding keeps output length consistent with the original windowed interface so alignment metrics still work.
